description: Na₃InCl₆ is alpha Rhenium trioxide-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a NaInCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaInCl₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent InCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.69 Å. In is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form InCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All In-Cl bond lengths are 2.52 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one In atom.
